What we do

Lawn care that treats your yard like our own.

From weekly cuts to hurricane-season cleanup, we handle the island's sandy soil and salt air so your yard looks its best year-round.

Mowing & Edging

Weekly or bi-weekly cuts with crisp edges along driveways, walks, and beds — every visit, on schedule.

Hedge & Shrub Trim

Clean lines for hedges and shrubs that hold up against salt air and coastal wind.

Storm & Debris Cleanup

Fast turnaround on palm fronds, downed limbs, and yard debris after a storm rolls through.

Weed Control

Seasonal programs built for sandy coastal soil, so grass stays thick and weeds stay out.

Seasonal Cleanups

Spring and fall resets for beds, mulch, and overgrowth — great for a fresh start each season.

Rental Turnover Care

Reliable mow-and-go service for property managers keeping beach rentals guest-ready.

Palm Tree Trimming

Cleaning up dead fronds and shaping palms so they stay healthy and hurricane-ready.
